recommendation: Keep the commit as-is. It is a narrow correction to active StructureDefinition source that completes the prior FHIR-45044 application; no further core source work is needed for this issue.
issue_request: FHIR-45044 was an Applied/Persuasive FHIR-core ImagingSelection change request raised for R6. It requested textual requirements clarifying that seriesUid identifies a series within studyUid, instance.uid identifies an SOP Instance within seriesUid, and the related series and instance numbers correspond to their UID elements.
initial_application: Commit a9b193fe26ebac455ff45f606bd759a9df076e32 applied the issue by adding requirements text for ImagingSelection.seriesUid, ImagingSelection.seriesNumber, ImagingSelection.instance.uid, and ImagingSelection.instance.number. The application was substantively present, but the instance.uid requirement used `seriesUID` rather than the actual FHIR element name `seriesUid`.
additional_context: ImagingSelection is active in source/fhir.ini, making source/imagingselection/structuredefinition-ImagingSelection.xml the current-build source. Later ImagingSelection commits for FHIR-48101, FHIR-48106, and FHIR-51645 preserved the requested FHIR-45044 semantics; FHIR-48106 corrected the same casing pattern for seriesNumber, while the instance.uid requirement still retained `seriesUID`. Zulip and Confluence searches found no directly relevant community evidence changing the Jira/source conclusion.
reconciliation: Changed only ImagingSelection.instance.uid requirements text from `seriesUID` to `seriesUid`; the other requested requirements text was already present and left unchanged.
source_changes: source/imagingselection/structuredefinition-ImagingSelection.xml: changed ImagingSelection.instance.uid requirements text to reference `seriesUid` instead of `seriesUID`.
